sourceMetadata.sourceDescription: Issue-level record for the Shanghai Manhua / 上海漫畫 periodical issue dated 1928-05-19. Use this as a parent source for page-level graphic material, pictorial/comics layout, advertising fragments, and Shanghai urban visual culture; scans remain source-linked only until reuse terms and object/page boundaries are reviewed.
